description: This file defines a PHP trait 'ModelTrait' used in a REST API serializer context within the OrangeHRM project. It provides methods for setting filters, attribute names, and entity objects, and for converting an entity to an array with nested normalization capabilities.

methods.name: setFilters
methods.description: Sets the filter array to determine which attributes to include in the serialization.

methods.name: setAttributeNames
methods.description: Overrides or sets attribute names for the serialized output.

methods.name: setEntity
methods.description: Assigns the entity object that will be serialized.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the entity to an array based on the filters and attribute mappings, including nested attributes.

methods.name: makeNestedArray
methods.description: Helper method to create nested arrays from dot-separated keys.

methods.name: normalizeNestedCollection
methods.description: Handles normalization of nested collections, invoking getter methods on objects within collections.
